sources.title: 越南汉喃研究院馆目1168《唐安丹鑾范家世譜》：A.909／VHv.1353两抄本、1820编引及斗数简述
sources.provider: Institute of Hán-Nôm Studies (VASS), first-party manuscript catalog
sources.quality_notes: A.909 300pp 30x19 and VHv.1353 162pp 29x17 are distinct institutional manuscript shelfmarks. 1820 is redaction/preface, not dated impression/copy. Catalog A.909 has short Ziwei subject description; EFEO MF II/2/227 is unbound surrogate lead. Does not prove Pham Khue teaching or algorithm.

sources.title: Trần Kim Anh 1996《Đường An Đan Loan Phạm gia thế phả, một cuốn phả quý》：两抄本与斗数医方择宅篇目
sources.provider: Institute of Hán-Nôm Studies hosted 1996 research report
sources.quality_notes: Author reports A909 copyist errors and contents part 8 'Đẩu số y phương khắc trạch'; VHv1353 other addendum and scribal error warning. Article is a reading report, not shared physical glyph SHA, direct ancient 18C lineage or exact 2019 pp117-118 affinal quote. 'Doushu' part title does not define a Ziwei mechanical rule.

sources.title: 《汉喃杂志》1994/4馆藏影像目录：唐安丹鑾范家世譜 A.909照相/缩微记录
sources.provider: Institute of Hán-Nôm Studies hosted Tạp chí Hán Nôm 4/1994
sources.quality_notes: Catalog item associated with A909, metadata suggests photograph from microfilm and unspecified film number; separately cataloged EFEO MF II/2/227 is not independently mapped to this object. It is a surrogate access lead and not extra ancient textual witness nor target folio.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A909/VHv1353 same work does not prove identical text or direct copy relationship
1996 'Doushu' section existence does not verify 2019 Pham Khue/Pham Gia Van affinal teacher passage
Modern catalog and microfilm do not establish historic date or mechanism of transmission
